name: Automaton Bomber's unconditional Ranged 4 attack bonus
notes: Automaton Bomber's Ranged 4 needs no Class Bonus (unlike most Ranged allies), so it's seeded directly onto player 2's field, awake and Distant. Rule 1.h blocks the opening player's own turn 1 attack, so player 1 ends turn 1 with a single CustomInput Pass (no decision is pending, so this action itself ends the turn rather than declining anything) before player 2 attacks on turn 2. DISTANT is on the persistent-turn-effects allowlist and only expires at the end of its own controller's turn, so it survives player 1's end-of-turn-1 cleanup untouched.

rulesClauses: Ranged 4 (As long as this unit is distant, its attacks get +4 POWER.)
